HypothesizedGapReason: Maintainer attention dropped after a PHP 7.4 compatibility push. The last pre-gap commits (Jan 2020) are PHP 7.4 deprecation fixes by maintainer Fredrick Brennan, and no commits appear Feb-Jul 2020. README lists Brennan as maintainer 2017-2021, and his Nov 2020 README edit says paid support is not offered right now. Cause not stated in any commit message.
WhyRecovered: Outside contributors sent bug and security fixes through numbered PRs (#376, #377, #378, #380) on 2020-08-10 to 2020-08-15: ban lookup used the wrong variable, an information leak in thread.html, and a Chromium capitalization bug.
WhoRecovered: New people (papereth, Eman Gamer, Sardach and later panfu28), not the maintainer. Later revival (2023-2024) came from new contributors and maintainers (Zankaria, RealAngeleno, Lorenzo Yario).
Notes: Vichan grew fast from its Tinyboard fork origins (peak 1,080 commits in 2013), shrank to 13-24 commits a year in 2018-2020, and had a revival in 2023-2024 (152 and 521 commits) under new people. The 6-month gap in 2020 follows a maintainer-led PHP 7.4 fix and ends with outside contributors fixing bugs, and the README states the project reached end of life. The repo was archived by its owner on 2026-07-06, so it is marked Inactive even though that date is a commit.
